a.speaker: What is this?
a.text:
You have seen: {clue_list}.

Several collapses look alike for the first hour. What do the signs say?

options.text: A pulse from high up. Something physical hit every circuit at once: old iron runs, new cars and phones died.
A pulse from high up. Phones died in people's hands and there's nothing in the sky.
A big blackout. It'll be back by morning.

wrong.speaker: What is this?
wrong.text: That doesn't explain a dead phone in a stranger's hand, or a car with no wires to cut. You'll know soon enough. Everyone will.

right.speaker: STOPPED CLOCKS
right.text:
One silent flash above the clouds has killed the grid and most electronics for longer than a year. No outside help is coming; everywhere is here.

What still works: Old Iron (points and carburetors, hand tools, bicycles) and whatever you sealed away. What doesn't: almost everything you bought after 1980.

One doubt remains: is a war coming next? The Relay's ham operators will know, if you can hear them.

Lesson perk gained: Light Discipline. Your household's light adds half the Profile, and the dark is a little less blind.
